intro: Boring Road & Patliputra is the band of established colonies north of Bailey Road: Boring Road and the colonies off it, Sri Krishna Puri and North Sri Krishna Puri, Kidwaipuri, the East and West Boring Canal Road belt with Buddha Colony and Anandpuri, Shivpuri, Shastri Nagar, Patliputra Colony and, on the Ganga, Digha. It is largely a mid-rise zone. Families live in older independent houses on colony lanes, in small and mid-sized apartment buildings put up by local builders, and in two- and three-bedroom flats in North Sri Krishna Puri. Only Digha adds real high-rise towers beside its traditional houses.

Tutors reach these colonies by road; no metro station is open here, and the Red Line under Bailey Road near Shastri Nagar is still under construction. Two-wheelers suit the narrower colony lanes better than cars. At the riverside end, Digha Bridge Halt has trains towards Patliputra Junction and Patna Junction, the riverfront expressway starts at Digha, and the elevated corridor from Digha helps tutors coming from the south-west. The Boring Road crossing is the pinch point in the evening, and the temple in Shivpuri draws a Thursday crowd, so class times that sidestep those windows run more smoothly.

Because the colonies sit so close together, many families here end up with a tutor who lives two or three lanes away and can ride over after the evening rush. NXTutors builds the shortlist in that order: tutors living in this zone, then those who travel to it, then tutors from elsewhere in Patna, and online tutors last, for subjects where the right specialist lives across the city. Each request brings two or three matched tutors with their fees on the profile, the first class is a free demo, and you can change tutor later at no cost.
faqs: Is it enough to tell a tutor I live on Boring Road?

Usually not. Boring Road itself is lined with shops, offices and commercial-cum-residential buildings, and most families live in the colonies that open off it, such as Nageshwar Colony, Sri Krishna Puri or North Sri Krishna Puri. Name your colony, building or lane and a nearby landmark so the first visit starts on time.
How does a tutor reach a home in Digha?

By road or rail. Digha Bridge Halt has passenger trains towards Patliputra Junction and Patna Junction, and the riverfront expressway and elevated corridor let tutors from other parts of the city skip the older inner roads. Digha mixes traditional houses and high-rise towers, so confirm how your building admits visitors before the demo.
Do homes in Patliputra Colony and Kidwaipuri need gate registration?

Mostly not. Patliputra Colony, a cooperative colony formed in 1954, is largely independent houses where the tutor arrives at the door, with some newer apartment buildings that keep a register. Kidwaipuri, also called P&T Colony, has homes on quiet internal roads and low-rise flats with a single building gate.
Can my child's tutor be someone from the same colony?

Often, yes. NXTutors lists tutors who live in this zone first, so a tutor from your own or the next colony appears before tutors from elsewhere in Patna. From the two or three matched tutors on your shortlist you pick one for a free demo, see the fee in advance, and can switch later for free.

intro: Bailey Road & Danapur follows Patna's main western road from its administrative stretch out through Raja Bazar, Rukanpura and Saguna More to Danapur, with the old town of Khagaul beside it. The housing tells the story of a city growing west. Raja Bazar and Rukanpura are dense with two- and three-bedroom flats in small complexes by local builders, Saguna More adds large gated townships with many towers alongside plots and builder floors, and Danapur has apartments, houses and the cantonment, which runs on its own rules. Khagaul is an older town of houses and flats around its railway station.

The Red Line of Patna Metro is being built beneath Bailey Road, from Danapur Cantonment towards the city, but no station on it is open yet, and construction barriers can slow parts of the road. Tutors therefore come by two-wheeler, car or auto. Rail helps at both ends: Patliputra Junction stands in Rukanpura, and Danapur railway station, headquarters of its division, is in Khagaul on the Delhi-Kolkata main line. Office-hour traffic is heavy along the whole corridor, so a tutor who lives on your stretch of the road is usually more reliable than one crossing the city.

That is the logic NXTutors follows. For a request from Saguna More or Raja Bazar, tutors living in this zone are shown first, then tutors who travel to the Bailey Road corridor, then others in Patna, with online tutors covering specialist subjects. You get a shortlist of two or three matched tutors, each tutor's fee is visible before you book, and the first lesson is a free demo held at home or online. If a township gate or a changed timetable makes the arrangement awkward later, you can switch to another tutor without paying for the change.
faqs: Is any Patna Metro station open on Bailey Road?

Not yet. The Red Line is under construction beneath Bailey Road, with planned stations including Danapur, Saguna Mor, RPS Mor, Patliputra, Raja Bazar and Patna Zoo, but none is running. Until it opens, tutors travel by two-wheeler, car or auto, and metro work can slow some stretches of the road.
What should a Saguna More family arrange for a tutor visiting a gated township?

Speak to the main gate before the demo. Large townships here record every visitor, so give the guard the tutor's name and lesson time, and ask how regular weekly visitors are handled. Smaller apartment buildings nearby usually need only a call from the gate to the flat when the tutor arrives.
How does home tuition work inside Danapur Cantonment?

The cantonment has its own entry rules, so ask at the cantonment gate how a visitor is admitted before you book the demo, and pass the procedure on to the tutor. Civilian apartment buildings elsewhere in Danapur usually just register visitors at the gate. A tutor from Danapur or Saguna More is the most practical match.
Do I pay for the first class with a Bailey Road tutor?

No. The first class with the tutor you choose is a free demo, whether at home or online. You see each matched tutor's fee on the profile before booking, so there are no surprises, and if the demo does not suit your child you can try another tutor from the same shortlist.

intro: Kankarbagh & Rajendra Nagar covers the large residential spread of east-central Patna: Kankarbagh from Ashok Nagar to Kumhrar, the planned colony of Rajendra Nagar with its numbered roads and parks, crowded and central Kadamkuan near the station, and the Bhootnath Road belt through Bahadurpur Housing Colony. Housing varies block by block. Kankarbagh is a patchwork of family houses, builder floors and open plots, with more and more flats rising around its market roads; Rajendra Nagar pairs older houses with newer flats; Kadamkuan has two-bedroom flats among shops and warehouses; and Bhootnath Road is densely built with residential complexes.

This is the one Patna zone where a tutor can already ride the metro. Blue Line trains start from Malahi Pakri in Kankarbagh and call at Bhootnath on their way to Zero Mile and the bus terminal at the far end, while the tunnelled section that will serve Rajendra Nagar is still being built. Trains at Rajendra Nagar Terminal and Patna Junction widen the options. Roads are the problem: market roads fill in the evening, Kadamkuan stays crowded most of the day with little parking, and Bhootnath Road jams at batch changeover times, so when a lesson is held counts as much as who teaches it.

Living near a station widens the choice here, since a tutor on the Blue Line can arrive by metro and a short auto ride. NXTutors still starts the list with tutors who live in Kankarbagh, Rajendra Nagar, Kadamkuan or around Bhootnath Road, then tutors who travel into the zone, after them tutors from across Patna, and online tutors to close any gap. Two or three matched tutors are suggested for each request, every tutor's fee is visible before you book, and the first class with your choice is a free demo. Switching to a different tutor later costs nothing.
faqs: Which metro station is nearest for a tutor coming to Kankarbagh?

Malahi Pakri, the Blue Line station that opened in July 2026 on the 90 Feet road. From there trains run through Bhootnath to Zero Mile, for now without stopping at Khemnichak, whose station is still being finished. A tutor living near the line can ride in and take a short auto to most Kankarbagh homes.
How do I help a tutor find my house in Rajendra Nagar?

Start with your road number. Rajendra Nagar is a planned colony whose streets are numbered, with open green spaces separating the blocks, so that number, plus your house or building, pins down almost any address. Tutors coming by rail can use Rajendra Nagar Terminal; the nearest working metro station is Malahi Pakri in Kankarbagh.
Is Kadamkuan better suited to home or online lessons?

Both work with some planning. Kadamkuan is central and close to Patna Junction, but its roads are congested through most of the day and there is little room to park, so a nearby tutor on a scooter or motorbike copes most easily. For a specialist subject taught from further away, online sessions save the journey.
What do home tutors in Kankarbagh charge?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Every tutor sets their own rate and shows it on the profile, so you know it before the free demo.

intro: Gandhi Maidan, Ashok Rajpath & Old Patna runs along the Ganga from Bankipur, the old civil station around the great ground, down Ashok Rajpath to Patna City, the historic eastern town. Housing here is the most varied in Patna. Around Gandhi Maidan, many families live in apartment buildings tucked among the hotels and shops of the commercial blocks to the south. Along Ashok Rajpath, the southern side holds older houses close to the market frontage, while institutions line the northern side. In Patna City, neighbourhoods such as Jhauganj, Marufganj, Rambagh and Machharhatta are close-built lanes of older homes.

Travel into the zone has changed recently. The riverfront expressway, now open all the way from Digha to Didarganj, meets Ashok Rajpath at several points, so a tutor from the north-west can use it and join the old road close to your lane. Patna Junction, first called Bankipore Junction, serves the western end and Patna Sahib station the old city. Underground Blue Line stations at Gandhi Maidan and Akashvani are under construction. Ashok Rajpath is among the busiest roads in the city, so lessons that avoid college opening and closing times, and a two-wheeler or e-rickshaw for the lanes, keep classes on schedule.

Families here often find the right tutor lives in the same old neighbourhood, which is why NXTutors lists tutors from this zone first. After them come tutors who travel to Bankipur, Ashok Rajpath or Patna City, then tutors from the wider city, and then online tutors, useful when a specialist lives across Patna or when big events at the Maidan clog the roads. The shortlist holds two or three matched tutors, each fee is shown on the profile before you book, and the first class is free as a demo. Moving to another tutor later is free as well.
faqs: How do tutors from Digha or Boring Road reach Patna City now?

Usually along the riverfront expressway, which has run from Digha to Didarganj since April 2025 and connects with Ashok Rajpath at nine points. That avoids much of the crawl on the old road. For the last stretch into the lanes of the old city, a two-wheeler or e-rickshaw works far better than a car.
What directions should an old-city family give a first-time tutor?

Describe the route from the nearest main road. The old city's lanes rarely follow house numbers, so the name of your neighbourhood, such as Jhauganj or Marufganj, the gali, and something recognisable at its mouth guide the tutor far better. Keep your phone at hand for the first visit, since most homes open straight onto the lane.
Do events at Gandhi Maidan affect lessons nearby?

They can. Central roads around the Maidan are crowded at office hours and during large events held on the ground, which slows any tutor crossing the area. Keep a fixed off-peak slot, and on event days move that lesson online. Flats in the surrounding commercial blocks may also need the tutor's name at the gate.
Will I see how much a tutor charges before the demo?

Yes. Every tutor on NXTutors sets their own fee and shows it on the profile, so you see it before booking. The shortlist has two or three matched tutors, with those living nearest your part of the old city first, and the first class with the tutor you choose is a free demo.

intro: Anisabad, Gardanibagh & Phulwari is the south-western side of Patna, where established housing near the administrative quarter gives way to the city's newer growth. Gardanibagh is the settled end, with private apartment buildings and a state housing project for government officers, with Kidwaipuri and Jakkanpur as neighbours. Anisabad, around its busy roundabout, mixes flats of various sizes, plotted homes, builder floors, shops and offices. Phulwari Sharif, long known for its Sufi shrines, has spread far beyond its old core, and newer apartment buildings now make up much of its housing next to houses and plots.

Getting here means the road: there is no metro in this zone, and the nearest planned central stations are still under construction, so tutors ride a two-wheeler, drive or take an auto. Rail is an option at two points, Patna Junction near Gardanibagh and Phulwari Sharif's own station on the main line to Howrah and Delhi. A national highway cuts through Phulwari, a four-lane elevated road linking the Anisabad roundabout with Phulwari is only at the planning stage, and the existing elevated road north towards Digha already speeds up trips to that side. The roundabout itself is the bottleneck at peak hours.

For families here, a nearby tutor usually means one from the same side of the roundabout, and NXTutors ranks the list that way: tutors living in Anisabad, Gardanibagh or Phulwari Sharif first, then those who travel to this part of Patna, then the rest of the city, then online tutors, who suit specialist subjects taught from north or central Patna. Each request returns two or three matched tutors, each with a fee you can see before booking. The first class is a free demo, and switching tutor later carries no charge.
faqs: Why does the Anisabad roundabout matter when choosing a tutor?

Because it carries heavy traffic at peak times and slows almost every journey across this zone. Someone living in Anisabad itself or towards Phulwari can reach an evening class without crossing it. The proposed elevated road over this stretch is not built yet, so for now plan the tutor and the slot around the roundabout.
What does a government housing campus in Gardanibagh need before a tutor visits?

Through the gate, with notice. Campuses and apartment buildings here check every visitor, so share your block and flat details with the tutor and let the guards know the name and time beforehand. Patna Junction is close by for tutors arriving by train; most others ride in or take an auto.
Can a tutor reach Phulwari Sharif by train?

Yes. Phulwari Sharif station sits on the main line between Howrah and Delhi, which is useful for tutors living elsewhere along the railway. Most still ride or drive in along the national highway through the area. Houses here let the tutor walk straight up to the door, while newer apartment buildings usually take the tutor's details once at the gate.
What if the tutor we pick after the demo stops suiting us?

Switch at no cost. After the free demo you continue with the tutor who fits, and if timings or teaching style stop working later, NXTutors lines up another matched tutor, again nearest first. Each tutor's fee is on their profile before you book, so any change is made with full information.
